source.organization: Bundesanzeiger Verlag GmbH (for the Federal Ministry of Justice)
source.license: Free view only since DiRUG 2022-08-01; reuse/redistribution not granted

access.note: Free to VIEW, but no bulk and no free retrieval API. Portal terms restrict automated mass retrieval. The official 'Massendatenschnittstelle' (webservice@rt.bundesanzeiger.de) is for SUBMITTING statements, not retrieval.

pagination.note: No documented bulk/retrieval transport. Do NOT implement direct portal scraping under these terms — use openregister_financials_api or bundesanzeiger_reports instead.

parsing.notes: If/when financial XBRL is obtained (via a licensed route), parse with an XBRL toolkit against the HGB taxonomy. Size class governs which concepts exist; micro/small often have balance sheet only (no revenue/net_income).

mapping_rules.financial_statements: One record per fiscal_year x (consolidated true/false). Map to the financial_statements[] array of the country profile.
mapping_rules.currency: Store with every figure; usually EUR.
mapping_rules.nullability: Treat revenue/net_income/employees as nullable — absent for micro/small filers.
mapping_rules.matching: Resolve to the registry spine via registrar+register number, else fuzzy name+seat match.

fixture_requirements: large filer with full balance sheet + P&L + notes + audit opinion (revenue/net_income present)
small GmbH with abridged balance sheet only (revenue/net_income NULL)
consolidated (Konzernabschluss) and single-entity (Einzelabschluss) for the same group/year
statement rendered as HTML/PDF (no clean XBRL) to exercise the extraction fallback

live_test_plan.smoke: Not applicable until a licensed retrieval route is chosen — do not scrape the portal in bulk.
live_test_plan.full: Out of scope for direct implementation. Obtain financials via openregister_financials_api (paid) or bundesanzeiger_reports (free, per-company) and parse the resulting XBRL/HTML.

blockers: No documented bulk download or free retrieval API.
Free viewing does not grant reuse/redistribution rights — license clearance needed before storing.
Portal terms restrict automated mass retrieval; the official bulk interface is submission-only.
Company↔statement matching has no shared numeric key with the registry spine.
